comment: Each rule: when a blueprint matches ALL keys in 'when', every id listed in 'forbid' is disallowed. Family-level incompatibilities also live inline in families.json (incompatible_endings / incompatible_revelations); rules here cover cross-library cases.

items.reason: Wrong Question ends on an unanswered reframing; deflation or banality endings contradict the open new question
Vanishing Object dissolves the question; shifting the burden of proof presumes the question survives
Boring Truth's deflation is undercut by grand scale-exit or instrument-doubt gestures
Self-Application must end inside the loop; handing the question to another authority escapes the loop
Double Bind already IS a refused synthesis; doubling the gesture is a detectable signature
Third Thing's premise-naming is itself a displacement; a displacement ending duplicates the move
Load-Bearing Anecdote needs returns to the opening; corridor and cold-open rhythms fight the return structure
Simultaneity Problem is about narrative order; an example-borne thesis hides the ordering claim entirely
Untranslatable needs fine option-level distinctions; terse options cannot carry the near-miss translations
an immediately stated thesis leaves nothing for a retrospective-frame ending to reveal
a never-stated thesis with an ambush topology stacks two withholding devices; sets become unfair, not hard
retrospective reveal needs an even or front-weighted surface; steadily building rhythms telegraph the late turn
opening with the thesis question after a retrospective reveal rewards skipping the passage's design
a retrospective-frame ending needs weight at the end; shrinking rhythms starve the final paragraph
Returned Key requires a planted opening image; a cold open plants argument, not image
the miniaturist's short declaratives cannot sustain three long undifferentiated blocks
the agent-less cartographer cannot narrate a personal anecdote structure convincingly
escalating denial is an abstraction-first device; the reporter persona builds from observation
the cold enthusiast's flat affect cannot carry conversion narratives or sided frictions
Scale Shift already lives on a scale jump; a scale-exit ending repeats the family's signature move
Instrument Effect ending in Instrument Doubt doubles the same gesture — a learnable pairing
Hospitable Critic plus double-tone topology over-concentrates the set on tone; coverage collapses
Category Refugee denies stable definition; a definitional-smuggle thesis presumes one
Threshold arguments plus moderate-extremism distractors collide: threshold claims read as extremity calibration already
Minority Report steelmans a view; straw-vendor distractors would duplicate the passage's own contrast device
